    [0] = LAYOUT(

        KC_D, KC_E, KC_F,
        KC_G, KC_H, KC_I

    /*

     * | Backlight Step | Use USB port for output        |                     |
     * | Backlight Tgl  | Use Bluetooth for output       | (currently pressed) |

    [1] = LAYOUT(
        _______, OU_AUTO, QK_BOOT,
        BL_STEP, OU_USB,  _______,
        BL_TOGG, OU_BT,   _______
    )
